assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production sprite atlas for a premium fantasy racing party game. Create one square 4 by 4 grid of sixteen isolated 3D painted game item icons, genuinely transparent background. Each of the 16 equal square cells contains exactly one centered icon, large readable silhouette, at least 12 percent transparent padding inside every cell, no overlaps between cells, no text, no numbers, no frames, no floor. Warm polished gold, emerald/teal enamel with vivid distinctive accent colors, cinematic soft lighting, same camera angle and style across all icons. Row 1 left to right: winged emerald running boot; sleek red rocket pointing right with small orange exhaust; powerful twin purple rocket booster pointing right; spiked cobalt blue turtle shell with tiny silver wings pointing right. Row 2: golden lightning bolt with small dark storm cloud; translucent cyan round magical shield with gold rim; ornate silver handheld mirror with violet reflective face; compact brass engine with emerald piston. Row 3: strong red horseshoe magnet with gold ends; bright yellow banana peel; dark circular grassy trap hole viewed from above diagonally; two intertwined curved magenta and cyan exchange arrows. Row 4: pair of golden dice with colored pips; golden spring with emerald platform; turquoise blazing comet pointing right; glowing electric green crystal battery. Icons are polished sculpted collectible objects with soft internal shading; preserve crisp transparent edges. Output the asset sheet alone, no interface or scene. Strict 4 columns, 4 rows, equal cell spacing.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: horizontally seamless side-scrolling fantasy racecourse background, wide landscape 3:1 composition. A gorgeous royal running stadium in teal and warm gold, painterly 3D game environment, afternoon sunlight. Strict horizontal layered layout suitable for 2D racing sprites added later. Upper quarter: distant lush cliffs, blue sky, cream castle architecture, repeating teal pennants, distant spectators represented only as softly painted dots; low elegant gold-and-stone railing across entire width. Lower three quarters: four broad parallel perfectly horizontal emerald grass racing lanes with slender cream horizontal separation lines, subtle textured mown grass and tiny scattered flowers. At the very bottom a slender foreground teal and gold decorative railing. Left and right edges match for looping horizontal scroll. Flat side-on race camera with no vanishing-point road, no receding lanes. No characters, no vehicles, no items, no text, no lettering, no numerals, no start line or finish line, no prominent center object. Beautiful detailed materials but uncluttered grass lanes for readable characters. Width substantially greater than height.
